parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
The rule content. Use a conditional expression to match user requests. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
- Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
- Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, for example, (http.host eq \"video.example.com\").

For the complete syntax of rule expressions, refer to <props="china">https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/edge-security-acceleration/esa/user-guide/work-with-rules-engine/</props><props="intl">https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/edge-security-acceleration/esa/user-guide/work-with-rules-engine/</props>

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Valid values:
- on: enabled.
- off: disabled.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

parameters.name: WaitingRoomId
parameters.description: The ID of the waiting room to bypass.
